notes.content:

Hey everyone, 

Festival Tycoon solo dev Johannes has just posted a dev update including: 

[list][*] looking for playtesters
[*] teasing new gameplay mechanics
[*] new stage setups for Rock bands! 
[*] UI updates and hipster clippy! 
[*] a bug that allows you to kick your friends through a festival (please don't do this!) [/list]

The full update can be found here: 

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1326270/announcements/detail/2972924719012357460

notes.title: The big localization update
notes.content:
Hi folks!
 
Just wanted to let y’all know that we’ve just given the Exo One Prologue a big localization update! You can now play this first little taste of Exo One in:
 
[list][*] English
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Chinese (Simplified or Traditional)
[*] Japanese
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Spanish
[*] Russian[/list]
 
That’s a lotta languages! Hopefully, this will open up the Prologue to a whole bunch of new people looking for a serene, otherworldly (and FREE!) gaming fix.
 
This update also includes some major and minor big fixes plus improvements to ensure players have the smoothest experience possible.
 
Played the Prologue and liked it? I’d be eternally grateful if you could head over to the main game page and chuck the game a Wishlist - it really does make all the difference for a tiny team like ours.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/773370/Exo_One/
 
Happy floating!
-Jay
